items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: And that's where I told them we had Maurice... My band was still up then. And that's where I told them we had Maurice and, uh, Rika Ellis.

ctx.x: Ask him if the band was up at the beginning of the war. If it was off? Up at the beginning of the war.

He said was the band made up at the beginning of the war? Yeah. Uh huh. Yeah. I must have been around, 1918. The war, the beginning of the war in 1917, wasn't it? Uh, around 1918. Ask him who he was playing with when the war was over, when the war ended. You said who was you playing with when the war ended. And that's where I told them we had Maurice. And, uh, uh, I'll say. I'll say. I'll say. I'll say. Uh huh. I'll say.
